# What differs from upstream Shoelace

Saipem DS is a fork of Shoelace 2.20.1 (commit `25bd8ec7`). The npm package is still called `@shoelace-style/shoelace` and the tags still start with `sl-`, so it is easy to confuse with the original. What you remember about Shoelace, Web Awesome (`wa-*`) or the docs on shoelace.style is **not** a reliable source for this library: the component references in this skill are.

Visual styles (colours, radii, density, focus rings) were also changed throughout: they come from the Saipem theme and must not be recreated by hand.

## Components that exist only in Saipem DS (19)

| Component | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`<sl-comment>`](components/comment.md) | Comments show a single message in a thread, e.g. |
| [`<sl-description-list>`](components/description-list.md) | Description lists show a grid of label/value pairs, e.g. |
| [`<sl-description-list-item>`](components/description-list-item.md) | A single label/value pair inside an [sl-description-list](components/description-list.md). |
| [`<sl-detail-panel>`](components/detail-panel.md) | A non-modal panel that shows details for a selected item alongside the page, e.g. |
| [`<sl-empty-state>`](components/empty-state.md) | Empty states communicate that a list or view has no content yet, e.g. |
| [`<sl-file-drop>`](components/file-drop.md) | File drops let users pick files by dragging them onto a zone or by browsing, e.g. |
| [`<sl-file-upload-item>`](components/file-upload-item.md) | Shows a single file's upload status in a list, e.g. |
| [`<sl-header>`](components/header.md) | Headers are the brand bar at the top of an application: logo, main navigation and global actions such as the project picker and the user menu. |
| [`<sl-header-item>`](components/header-item.md) | Header items are the entries in a [header's](components/header.md) main navigation. |
| [`<sl-selectable-item>`](components/selectable-item.md) | A compact, checkable row for small selection lists, e.g. |
| [`<sl-sidebar>`](components/sidebar.md) | Sidebars hold the secondary navigation of a page. |
| [`<sl-sidebar-group>`](components/sidebar-group.md) | Sidebar groups are titled sections of a [sidebar](components/sidebar.md) that hold sidebar items. |
| [`<sl-sidebar-item>`](components/sidebar-item.md) | Sidebar items are the links inside a [sidebar group](components/sidebar-group.md). |
| [`<sl-stat>`](components/stat.md) | Stats show a count with a label as an icon-first KPI card, e.g. |
| [`<sl-stat-group>`](components/stat-group.md) | Stat groups lay out a row of [stats](components/stat.md) that act as quick filters: selecting one filters a list to that status, selecting it again clears the filter. |
| [`<sl-status>`](components/status.md) | Statuses pair a coloured dot with a short label to show the state of a record, e.g. |
| [`<sl-step>`](components/step.md) | Steps are the individual stages of a [stepper](components/stepper.md). |
| [`<sl-stepper>`](components/stepper.md) | Steppers show where the user is in a multi-step process, such as creating and distributing a document. |
| [`<sl-table>`](components/table.md) | Tables display a list of records in columns, with optional sorting, row selection and pagination. |

## Upstream components with a changed API (13)

| Component | Changes |
| --- | --- |
| [`<sl-alert>`](components/alert.md) | `variant` accepts new values: 'accent' |
| [`<sl-avatar>`](components/avatar.md) | new attribute `size` ('small' \| 'medium' \| 'large'); new attribute `variant` ('primary' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'neutral' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| '') |
| [`<sl-badge>`](components/badge.md) | `variant` accepts new values: 'accent' |
| [`<sl-button>`](components/button.md) | `variant` accepts new values: 'accent' |
| [`<sl-card>`](components/card.md) | new attribute `variant` ('primary' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'neutral' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| ''); new CSS custom property `--accent-width` |
| [`<sl-dialog>`](components/dialog.md) | new attribute `variant` ('default' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'); new CSS part `status-icon` |
| [`<sl-icon>`](components/icon.md) | new attribute `variant` ('neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger') |
| [`<sl-icon-button>`](components/icon-button.md) | new attribute `variant` ('default' \| 'primary' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'neutral' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'); new attribute `size` ('small' \| 'large' \| 'x-large'); new attribute `filled` |
| [`<sl-input>`](components/input.md) | new attribute `status` ('success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| '') |
| [`<sl-select>`](components/select.md) | new attribute `status` ('success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| '') |
| [`<sl-tab>`](components/tab.md) | new attribute `card` |
| [`<sl-tag>`](components/tag.md) | `variant` accepts new values: 'accent' |
| [`<sl-textarea>`](components/textarea.md) | new attribute `status` ('success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| '') |
